locationQuality: Adequate — Belas Clube de Campo is a proven submarket with demonstrated transactional depth across multiple price tiers (ORION from €360K to Native.Townhouses from €1.355M), strong on-estate amenity infrastructure (GEO/ISO golf, UNESCO school, full services), and direct Lisbon access via A5/A9/IC19 in 15–20 minutes; the car-dependent suburban setting and the estate's lower average asking price (€3,846/m²) mean the address alone does not sustain the premium — it must be carried by the product.
designQuality: Adequate — UNStudio (founded 1988, Ben van Berkel and Caroline Bos) is an internationally credible studio with a body of delivered work, and the ground-floor garden / upper-floor panoramic programme shows a legible spatial concept; however, no published material schedule or detailed renders exist at this stage, so the degree of site-specificity to Serra da Carregueira cannot be confirmed, and Capinha Lopes Consulting's involvement is the delivery credibility anchor.
developerReputation: Strong — Kronos Homes has delivered multiple architecturally credited Portuguese projects including The One (Eduardo Souto de Moura, completed 2023) and Distrikt in Parque das Nações (>€180M in sales), and exited Palmares Ocean Living & Golf for approximately €400 million; no disputes or delivery failures found across all search queries; Millennium bcp named as strategic partner.
specificationCredibility: Adequate — BREEAM certification is targeted with specifically named systems (energy monitoring, EV infrastructure, thermal optimisation), covered parking is confirmed for all units, and the implied price/m² of €6,800–€7,800 is proportionate to the specification tier; the absence of a published material schedule is a gap but not unusual at off-plan launch stage.
propositionAuthenticity: Strong — pricing, typology range, architect commission, sustainability specification, and stated buyer profile (internationally mobile families, Lisbon-area commuters) are internally consistent; Kronos's pattern of commissioning internationally credible architects is evidenced by prior delivered projects (Souto de Moura, RCR Arquitectes, now UNStudio) rather than merely claimed.
recommendationLogic: No auto-disqualifier applies. No deferral trigger fires (lead and local architects confirmed, developer track record evidenced, pricing and delivery establishable from press).
